#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll mod = 998244353;

ll pow_mod(ll a, ll b) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

vector<ll> matMul(const vector<ll>& x, const vector<ll>& y) {
    return {
        (x[0] * y[0] + x[1] * y[2]) % mod,
        (x[0] * y[1] + x[1] * y[3]) % mod,
        (x[2] * y[0] + x[3] * y[2]) % mod,
        (x[2] * y[1] + x[3] * y[3]) % mod
    };
}

vector<ll> matPow(vector<ll> a, ll e) {
    vector<ll> res = {1, 0, 0, 1};
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = matMul(res, a);
        a = matMul(a, a);
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    ll n, m, L, R;
    cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;

    if ((n & 1) && (m & 1)) {
        cout << pow_mod((R - L + 1) % mod, n * m) << '\n';
    } else {
        ll cnt = R - L + 1;
        if (cnt % 2 == 0) {
            ll allbutone = pow_mod(cnt % mod, n * m - 1);
            cout << allbutone * (cnt / 2) % mod << '\n';
        } else {
            ll k = cnt / 2;
            vector<ll> mat = {k, k + 1, k + 1, k};
            vector<ll> res = matPow(mat, n * m);
            cout << res[0] << '\n';
        }
    }

    return 0;
}
